replacements.reason: Declare abort for fail-closed host bounds violations.

The console uses -1 as an unlimited formatting bound; native fortified libc rejects SIZE_MAX. Preserve every fitting output byte and reject an overrun before the result is consumed, rather than silently truncating.

Stage the original encoder in a bounded native stack scratch: each of at most 128 iterations emits at most five kerning bytes plus two glyph bytes, then close and terminator. Reject outputs exceeding the original 128-byte buffer before source state mutations.
